infoBanner: Recorded on Cardano · Voting is free

noWallet.body: A Cardano wallet lets you hold ADA (Cardano's currency) and pay the small fee to publish a proposal. Voters never need one — only proposal creators do.
noWallet.step1: Download <bold>Vespr</bold> — it's the easiest Cardano wallet for beginners, built for mobile.
noWallet.step2: Create your wallet and safely write down your recovery phrase.
noWallet.linkErrorMessage: Search for "Vespr Wallet" in the Play Store.

attachments.label: Attachments (optional)
attachments.helper: Up to {{max}} images to accompany your proposal
attachments.limitMessage: You can attach up to {{max}} images per proposal.
attachments.permissionMessage: Allow photo library access to attach an image.

validation.votersAtLeastMessage: Expected voters must be at least 2
validation.invalidDurationMessage: Duration must be at least 1 day

fees.foundationInfo: Foundation fee supports VoteBoxApp open-source development
fees.votingFree: Voting is FREE for all participants!

payment.title: Pay {{amount}} ADA to publish
payment.overpayMessage: You sent {{sent}} ADA, but only {{required}} ADA was required. This can't be refunded — continue anyway?

verifyErrors.malformed_hash: That isn't a transaction ID. It should be 64 letters and numbers. Copy it again from your wallet.
verifyErrors.not_found_or_pending: The payment hasn't arrived after 5 minutes. Check in your wallet that it was sent, then tap "Check payment and publish" again.
verifyErrors.wrong_recipient: This transaction doesn't pay the Foundation wallet address shown above.
verifyErrors.insufficient_amount: The amount sent is less than required — see the amount above.
verifyErrors.already_used: This transaction has already been used for another proposal.
verifyErrors.network_error: Could not reach the network to verify — check your connection and try again.

payment.step2: Send the payment from your Cardano wallet
payment.prefillNote: Vespr fills in the address and amount for you. With other wallets, paste the address and amount you copied in step 1.
payment.ownWalletNote: Send from your own wallet, not an exchange. The address you pay from is shown as the proposal's creator.
payment.openWalletFailedMessage: Open your Cardano wallet app yourself and send the payment to the address above.
payment.step3Helper: We'll recognise your payment by its exact amount and publish your proposal automatically, usually within a minute.
payment.exactNote: Send exactly this amount. The last digits are unique to your proposal, so we can recognise your payment.
payment.watchTimeout: We haven't seen your payment yet. If you've sent it, use the transaction ID below.
payment.fallbackToggle: Didn't publish automatically? Use the transaction ID
payment.fallbackHelper: Your wallet shows it in the payment's details, sometimes as "Tx hash". When you come back, VoteBoxApp finds it on your clipboard.
payment.foundOnClipboard: Transaction ID found on your clipboard
payment.waitingBody: This usually takes under a minute. Keep this screen open.
payment.faucetNote: VoteBoxApp runs on Cardano's test network, so you pay with free test ADA.

publish.queuedToast: ⏳ No connection — proposal queued, will publish when back online

success.title: 🎉 Proposal Published!
success.votingOpen: It's recorded on Cardano and voting is open now.

draft.discardMessage: Your title, description and photos will be deleted.
